name: Counter-Strike Global Map Pool
appliesTo: All tier 1 and tier 2 Counter-Strike competitions, for all teams (Kairos and non-Kairos) and all organizers in this continuity, with no rotation and no fixed end date.
notes: This is a permanent, continuity-wide fictional map pool, not tied to any single competition or organizer.
Mirage, Ancient, Anubis, and Vertigo are excluded from all official competitions under this ruleset.

Historical match records from before this ruleset was documented (for example the Kairos vs. Team Liquid private scrim referenced in episode-093, which included Mirage) are untouched; this ruleset governs official competitions going forward and is not retroactive.
Future competition records may reference this ruleset by id (see competition.schema.json's optional rulesetIds field) instead of duplicating the map list.
